text.en: Clients describe significant progress with puppies and nervous dogs, reporting that pets become visibly calmer and more confident within weeks. Handlers appreciate learning the behavioural reasons behind their dogs' actions rather than simply memorising obedience commands. Reviewers emphasize that the training establishes durable day-to-day habits.

Pet owners value the emphasis placed on understanding each dog's perspective, social systems, and individual temperament. Reviews mention successful work with hesitant pups and lively cocker spaniels learning to navigate encounters with other dogs. Handlers report feeling more attuned to their animals' signals and communication cues.

Reviewers warmly commend Antonella and her training team for combining deep behavioural expertise with approachable guidance and good humour. Clients highlight that sessions feel well structured, engaging, and supportive for first-time dog owners. Handlers appreciate the personalised attention provided during both group classes and private sessions.

q.en: What puppy training programmes are offered?

a.en: The centre runs beginner puppy classes as well as intermediate group courses and one-to-one behavioural consultations.

q.en: Do trainers provide assistance outside of scheduled classes?

a.en: Yes, clients highlight ongoing support via email, phone consultations, WhatsApp groups, and video reviews to assist with home practice.

q.en: How are the training fees viewed by participants?

a.en: Clients describe the course fees as very reasonable and good value considering the qualifications and level of ongoing support.
